question: According to Census 2011, which of the following languages is spoken by the least population in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanskrit**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanskrit** is spoken by the least population in India according to Census 2011.
 
• The Census of India, conducted every ten years, collects data on various demographic parameters including language.
 
• In Census 2011, Sanskrit was reported to have the least number of speakers among the listed languages.
 
• Sanskrit, despite being an ancient and classical language of India, is not widely spoken in contemporary times.
 
• Efforts are being made to revive and promote the use of Sanskrit through educational programs and cultural initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Census of India** is a comprehensive exercise that provides valuable insights into the demographic profile of the country.
 
• The census includes data on population, literacy, employment, housing, and various other socio-economic indicators.
 
• It is conducted by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India, under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• The first census in India was conducted in 1872, and since then, it has been conducted every decade.
 
• The data collected during the census is crucial for planning and policy-making at both the national and state levels.
 
• Language data from the census helps in understanding linguistic diversity and planning for language preservation and promotion.
